Spacecraft name MEPSI 3-4 (MEMS-based PicoSat Inspector)
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Organisation DARPA
Institution Military
Entity Government (Civil / Military)
Headquarters US
Oneliner

Tethered pair to demonstrate the capability of deploying an onboard miniature autonomous inspector.
Description

Demonstrate the capability of deploying an onboard miniature autonomous inspector, tasked to conduct visual inspection of the host satellite. Pair is tethered. Cold gas propulsion system, with 0.1N thrust with 5 thrusters. This propulsion system includes MEMS pressure transducers
